description:
Outdoor lighting at runtime: sun (directional light), sky light, sky atmosphere, volumetric clouds, height fog and the
global post process (exposure, grading). Follow the outdoor_lighting skill.
Workflow: get_environment (what exists, exposure mode, cloud coverage) -> set_sun or set_time_of_day first (it drives
the sky) -> set_clouds / set_atmosphere -> set_fog -> set_post_process for exposure -> screenshot and refine.
apply_mood is a one-step starting point. Missing parts: spawn them with actors.spawn_actor (SkyAtmosphere,
VolumetricCloud, SkyLight, ExponentialHeightFog, DirectionalLight). Arguments left out keep their current value.
name: lighting

tools.description:
One-step look for the sun, fog, clouds and grading, as one undo step. A starting point: refine with the other tools.
Returns: The mood and the parts that changed (parts the level lacks are skipped).

mood.description: Noon, Morning, Sunset, Night, Overcast or Foggy. Each sets physical sun and sky light, a matching locked exposure, fog, grading, ambient occlusion, contact shadows and reflections: the realistic starting point for outdoor scenes.

tools.name: lighting.apply_mood

returnValue.description: The mood and the parts that changed (parts the level lacks are skipped).

changed.description: Parts that changed: sun, fog, clouds, post_process.

returnValue.title: RuntimeMoodResult

tools.description:
Reads the whole lighting setup: sun, sky light, atmosphere, clouds (with material coverage/density), fog and post process (with the exposure mode, which decides the exposure bias range). Read it before changing lighting.
Returns: One section per part; a part the level lacks has an empty `actor`.
tools.name: lighting.get_environment

returnValue.description: One section per part; a part the level lacks has an empty `actor`.

actor.description: Empty when the level has no sky atmosphere.

rayleigh_scattering.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

actor.description: Empty when the level has no volumetric cloud.

bottom_altitude_km.description: Bottom of the cloud layer in km.

cast_shadows.description: Whether the sun casts cloud shadows (directional light setting).

coverage.description: Global coverage (-1 clear .. 1 overcast; scattered clouds -0.2..0). Only valid when CoverageParameter is set.

coverage_parameter.description: Name of the material's coverage parameter, empty if it has none.

density.description: Global density (light clouds ~0.008, overcast 0.02-0.04). Only valid when DensityParameter is set.

density_parameter.description: Name of the material's density parameter, empty if it has none.

layer_height_km.description: Thickness of the layer in km.

material.description: Cloud material path. Engine content (/Engine/...) is shared: changes go to a dynamic instance on this component.

shadow_strength.description: Cloud shadow strength on surfaces (directional light setting).

sky_light_occlusion.description: How much clouds block sky light from below (0-1).

actor.description: Empty when the level has no height fog.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

start_distance.description: Distance from the camera where fog starts, cm.

actor.description: Empty when the level has no unbound post process volume.

overridden.description: Settings this volume overrides (others use project defaults), e.g. ["exposure_bias", "bloom"].

actor.description: Empty when the level has no sky light.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

realtime_capture.description: Real-time capture follows sky changes; otherwise the tools recapture after changes.

actor.description: The light (node id or actor:Name); empty when the level has no directional light.

cast_cloud_shadows.description: Whether volumetric clouds cast shadows from this light.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

elevation.description: Elevation above the horizon in degrees (= -pitch).

source_angle.description: Angular diameter of the sun disc in degrees (soft shadows: larger).

returnValue.title: RuntimeEnvironment

tools.description:
Sets aside the level's own sun, sky light, atmosphere, clouds, fog and post process (the ones that came with the map), so a scene can bring its own lighting; tool-made ones are kept. Call again with hidden false to bring them back.
Returns: The actors changed.

hidden.description: true sets them aside, false brings them back.

tools.name: lighting.hide_environment

tools.description:
Sets the sky atmosphere's scattering (sky colour and haze). Undoable.
Returns: The atmosphere after the change. Fails if the level has no sky atmosphere.

rayleigh_scattering.description: Rayleigh colour [r, g, b]: clear [0.175, 0.41, 1.0], overcast about [0.45, 0.56, 0.75]. ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1)

tools.name: lighting.set_atmosphere

returnValue.description: The atmosphere after the change. Fails if the level has no sky atmosphere.

actor.description: Empty when the level has no sky atmosphere.

rayleigh_scattering.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

returnValue.title: RuntimeAtmosphereInfo

tools.description:
Sets the volumetric cloud layer, cloud shadows and (through its material) coverage and density. Coverage and density go to a dynamic instance of the cloud material on this component, so engine assets are never modified. Undoable.
Returns: The clouds after the change. Fails if the level has no volumetric cloud, or coverage/density is given but the cloud material has no such parameter (the error lists its scalar parameters).

bottom_altitude_km.description: Cloud base in km; 3-5 scattered, 0.5-2 overcast.

cast_shadows.description: Cloud shadows from the sun (directional light setting).

layer_height_km.description: Layer thickness in km; 5-8 scattered, 8-14 overcast.

tools.name: lighting.set_clouds

returnValue.description: The clouds after the change. Fails if the level has no volumetric cloud, or coverage/density is given but the cloud material has no such parameter (the error lists its scalar parameters).

actor.description: Empty when the level has no volumetric cloud.

bottom_altitude_km.description: Bottom of the cloud layer in km.

cast_shadows.description: Whether the sun casts cloud shadows (directional light setting).

coverage.description: Global coverage (-1 clear .. 1 overcast; scattered clouds -0.2..0). Only valid when CoverageParameter is set.

coverage_parameter.description: Name of the material's coverage parameter, empty if it has none.

density.description: Global density (light clouds ~0.008, overcast 0.02-0.04). Only valid when DensityParameter is set.

density_parameter.description: Name of the material's density parameter, empty if it has none.

layer_height_km.description: Thickness of the layer in km.

material.description: Cloud material path. Engine content (/Engine/...) is shared: changes go to a dynamic instance on this component.

shadow_strength.description: Cloud shadow strength on surfaces (directional light setting).

sky_light_occlusion.description: How much clouds block sky light from below (0-1).

returnValue.title: RuntimeCloudInfo

tools.description:
Sets exponential height fog. Undoable.
Returns: The fog after the change. Fails if the level has no height fog or a value is out of range.

color.description: Inscattering colour [r, g, b]. ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1)

start_distance.description: Distance in cm where fog starts, e.g. 3000.

tools.name: lighting.set_fog

returnValue.description: The fog after the change. Fails if the level has no height fog or a value is out of range.

actor.description: Empty when the level has no height fog.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

start_distance.description: Distance from the camera where fog starts, cm.

returnValue.title: RuntimeFogInfo

tools.description:
Sets the global post process: exposure (bias and auto exposure range), bloom and grading. Creates an unbound volume when the level has none. Undoable.
Returns: The post process after the change, with the exposure mode. Fails if a value is out of range.

exposure_bias.description: Exposure compensation in EV (-15..15). Auto exposure: -2..2; manual with physical lux: down to -14.

exposure_min.description: Auto exposure minimum brightness (EV100); with exposure_max it makes the exposure mode Auto.

tools.name: lighting.set_post_process

returnValue.description: The post process after the change, with the exposure mode. Fails if a value is out of range.

actor.description: Empty when the level has no unbound post process volume.

overridden.description: Settings this volume overrides (others use project defaults), e.g. ["exposure_bias", "bloom"].

returnValue.title: RuntimePostProcessInfo

tools.description:
Sets the sky light's intensity and colour (recaptures when not real-time). Undoable.
Returns: The sky light after the change. Fails if the level has no sky light.

color.description: [r, g, b], 0-1. ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1)

tools.name: lighting.set_sky

returnValue.description: The sky light after the change. Fails if the level has no sky light.

actor.description: Empty when the level has no sky light.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

realtime_capture.description: Real-time capture follows sky changes; otherwise the tools recapture after changes.

returnValue.title: RuntimeSkyLightInfo

tools.description:
Sets the sun's rotation, intensity, colour, temperature and shadow softness. Undoable.
Returns: The sun after the change. Fails if the level has no directional light or the target is not one.

color.description: Light colour [r, g, b], 0-1. ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1)

intensity.description: Physical lux: 100000 noon sun, 20000 to 40000 low sun, 2000 to 8000 sunset, under 1 moonlight. The camera exposure is locked to match, so the frame never blows out; fine-tune with set_post_process exposure_bias.

rotation.description: [pitch, yaw, roll]: pitch 0 = horizon, -90 = overhead, e.g. [-35, 120, 0]. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

source_angle.description: Sun disc angle in degrees (2-5 overcast, 15-30 when the disc is hidden).

target.description: Directional light; the level's first one when omitted. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: lighting.set_sun

returnValue.description: The sun after the change. Fails if the level has no directional light or the target is not one.

actor.description: The light (node id or actor:Name); empty when the level has no directional light.

cast_cloud_shadows.description: Whether volumetric clouds cast shadows from this light.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

elevation.description: Elevation above the horizon in degrees (= -pitch).

source_angle.description: Angular diameter of the sun disc in degrees (soft shadows: larger).

returnValue.title: RuntimeSunInfo

tools.description:
Places the sun for a clock hour on a sinusoidal day: 6 sunrise, 12 noon (overhead), 18 sunset, night below the horizon, and sets the sun's brightness (lux) and a matching locked exposure for that hour, so any hour renders correctly. Undoable.
Returns: The hour and the sun after the change. Fails if the hour is outside 0-24 or there is no directional light.

target.description: Directional light; the level's first one when omitted. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

yaw.description: Sun heading in degrees (default: keep), e.g. 120.

tools.name: lighting.set_time_of_day

returnValue.description: The hour and the sun after the change. Fails if the hour is outside 0-24 or there is no directional light.

actor.description: The light (node id or actor:Name); empty when the level has no directional light.

cast_cloud_shadows.description: Whether volumetric clouds cast shadows from this light.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1

elevation.description: Elevation above the horizon in degrees (= -pitch).

source_angle.description: Angular diameter of the sun disc in degrees (soft shadows: larger).

returnValue.title: RuntimeTimeOfDay
